requirements.statement: A user can sign up for their own account

criteria.must: A new user can create an account through the sign-up flow
A newly created account can immediately be used to sign in

requirements.statement: A user can sign in to the app

criteria.must: A registered user can sign in with their credentials
A signed-in user reaches their todo list after signing in

requirements.statement: A user can create a new todo with a short description

criteria.must: A signed-in user can submit a description to create a new todo
A newly created todo appears in the user's list as open (not done)

requirements.statement: A user can see their list of todos, showing which are open and which are done

criteria.must: A signed-in user sees a list of their own todos
Each todo in the list is shown as either open or done
A user never sees another user's todos in their list

requirements.statement: A user can mark a todo as done

criteria.must: A signed-in user can mark one of their open todos as done
A todo marked done is reflected as done in the user's list

requirements.statement: Todos have no edit or delete action — a todo can only move from open to done

criteria.must: The app offers no control to edit an existing todo's description
The app offers no control to delete a todo
The app offers no control to un-mark a done todo back to open

requirements.statement: Todo data is persisted in a database so a user's list survives across sessions and devices

criteria.must: A user's todos are still present after signing out and signing back in
